method: Read-only Android source review; no device execution, store publication or parser accuracy certification.
sourcePathConvention: Java paths are relative to android/app/src/main/java/com/butceapp/; other paths are repository-relative.
contentVerdict: Existing feature groups and free/Premium conditions agree with inspected implementation. Notification subfeatures, detailed assistant capabilities and local data deletion can be expanded.

platform.condition: Source version; current Google Play publication was not checked.

verified: Monthly income, expense and remaining/savings dashboard
Manual expense creation with person, category, date and description
Expense editing, deletion and bulk selection/deletion
Monthly repeated expenses for a selected count from 1 to 60
Installments stored as separate monthly expenses
Income frequency, savings and raise-date fields associated with people
conditions: Generated expense records, not bank connectivity or a separate loan/debt account system

verified: Person creation/editing and associated income items
Person and category breakdown in reports
Daily and monthly expenses and incomes
Budget-cycle start day selectable from 1 to 28
ML Kit OCR with local receipt parsing
Rewarded ad grants one extra receipt scan
conditions: No external generative AI/API key
Free: 5 scans per calendar month; Premium has no application quota
OCR accuracy depends on photo and receipt layout

verified: PDFBox text extraction with page-render/OCR fallback
Transaction selection and assigning a person
User-reviewed masked support-report sharing on failed parsing
conditions: Free: 1 PDF scan per calendar month; Premium has no application quota
Image import is distinct from PDF quota
Bank-specific code does not prove all statement layouts work
Previous-period comparison is not isolated per bank

verified: Income/expense distributions, person and category breakdowns
Monthly bar/line/pie charts and cumulative savings
Premium CSV export of all expense records
conditions: CSV fields: date, category, person, item, amount, description
No implemented PDF or XLSX report export was found
CSV is not a restorable database backup

verified: Expense average from positive-expense months in the last three months
Person incomes and applicable salary raises
conditions: Formula-based planning, not a generative AI prediction or guaranteed future result

verified: Goal name, target amount and saved amount
conditions: No automatic bank-balance import or verified goal deadline feature

verified: Budget overview and rule-based savings tips
conditions: Free: 3 questions per calendar day; Premium has no application quota
No external AI provider or API key
Keyword routing is limited; not every wording or compound question is understood

verified: Unusual spending increase and month-end budget-ratio alerts
conditions: Notification permission and relevant switches apply
WorkManager delivery depends on Android scheduling/battery restrictions; no exact-minute guarantee
Alerts are local rules, not AI forecasts

verified: Delete all local data and preferences after confirmation
conditions: Currency preference does not perform exchange-rate conversion
Privacy display mode is not screenshot protection
Purchase restoration does not restore budget data
Deleting local data is destructive; user confirmation is required in the app

local: Room database stores income, expenses, people, categories, raises and savings goals
OCR and budget-assistant processing occur locally
external: Firebase Analytics dependency is included; actual telemetry payload was not independently audited
Masked statement support text may leave the device only through user-initiated sharing
Premium CSV is written to a user-selected document destination
dataFlow.backup: Android allowBackup=false; no budget cloud sync or database restore implementation found

deliberateExclusions.reason: String resource advertises CSV/PDF, but implemented export only writes expense CSV

deliberateExclusions.claim: Cloud backup, full restore, multi-device sync
deliberateExclusions.reason: No implementation found; Android backup explicitly disabled

deliberateExclusions.claim: Generative AI or external AI provider integration
deliberateExclusions.reason: Assistant calls a local rule-based response generator

deliberateExclusions.claim: Bank account connection, separate debt/loan management
deliberateExclusions.reason: No corresponding navigation destination or database entity found; installments are expense records
Currency selection changes display format and symbol only

deliberateExclusions.claim: No data ever leaves the device
deliberateExclusions.reason: External account, ad, billing services and user-selected export/sharing are present
Bank-specific code paths are not a compatibility or accuracy certification

privacyOfReview: Credentials, environment files, signing configuration values, private sample statements/receipts and memory files were not inspected or copied. No absolute source-machine paths are included.
